## 会议论文与报告 Conference papers and presentations

- **2026年7月 July 2026** · 合作论文入选中国社会学会2026年学术年会“第八届传播社会学”分论坛（西安）。  
  A coauthored paper was accepted for the Eighth Sociology of Communication subforum at the 2026 Annual Conference of the Chinese Sociological Association, Xi’an.

- **2026年6月 June 2026** · **独作**论文《翻古与困古》参加南京师范大学新闻与传播学院、中国社会科学院新闻与传播研究所等主办的学术论坛，口头宣讲。  
  **Sole-authored** paper, 《翻古与困古》. Oral presentation at an academic forum co-organized by the School of Journalism and Communication at Nanjing Normal University, the Institute of Journalism and Communication at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, and other organizers.

- **2025年11月 November 2025** · **一作**论文《乡村文化组织的传播构成》参加中国新闻史学会新闻传播思想史专委会2025年年会（广州），口头宣讲。  
  **First-authored** paper, 《乡村文化组织的传播构成》. Oral presentation at the 2025 Annual Conference of the Committee on the History of Journalism and Communication Thought, Chinese Association for History of Journalism and Communication, Guangzhou.

- **2024年12月 December 2024** · **二作**论文参加中国社会学会技术社会学专业委员会冬季论坛“短视频与烟火气”主题研讨会，口头宣讲。  
  **Second-authored** paper. Oral presentation at the symposium “Short Videos and Everyday Life” (短视频与烟火气), part of the Winter Forum of the Sociology of Technology Committee, Chinese Sociological Association.

- **2024年6月 June 2024** · **二作**论文参加南京师范大学新闻与传播学院主办的“中国式现代化中的乡村传播与社会发展”学术论坛，口头宣讲。  
  **Second-authored** paper. Oral presentation at the academic forum “Rural Communication and Social Development in Chinese Modernization,” organized by the School of Journalism and Communication at Nanjing Normal University.
